evals.prompt: I have a system prompt for a support-ticket classifier, about 8000 tokens of instructions plus examples. Each ticket adds ~500 tokens and the reply is one word. We process 20k tickets/day. How much would this cost on the different Claude models, and does caching change the picture?
evals.expected_output: Model x effort cost matrix using ~8500 input tokens, small output estimate (~100 tokens), scaled to 20k calls, showing cached vs uncached input, with a recommendation (likely Haiku or Sonnet + cached prefix, batch API mention).

evals.prompt: how much would it cost to run this prompt at each effort level on opus 4.8? the prompt is in ~/prompts/refactor-plan.md and i expect maybe 5k tokens of output
evals.expected_output: Table restricted to claude-opus-4-8, all five effort levels, using --file with --output-tokens 5000; token source (API or heuristic) stated.

evals.prompt: Is it cheaper to run my nightly summarization job on Sonnet 5 at high effort or Opus 4.8 at medium? Input is about 40k tokens per run, output around 2k, 30 runs a month.
evals.expected_output: Direct comparison of the two named model/effort cells, scaled to 30 calls, with Sonnet 5 intro pricing noted if applicable, and a one-line answer naming the cheaper option.
